name: GraphiXS
definition: A graphical model for 4D Gaussian Splatting under uncertainty that generalizes the unnormalized mixture model of 3D/4DGS by introducing structured dependencies among random variables (cameras, time, components, rays) to enable Bayesian inference and regularization.
summary: GraphiXS is a probabilistic 4D Gaussian Splatting model that uses Bayesian inference and stochastic priors to handle uncertainty, making it robust to sparse views and missing frames.
